name: Zhejiang Orient Holdings Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Orient Holdings Group Co., Ltd. engages in the financial and quasi-financial businesses in the People's Republic of China. The company offers commodity and financial futures brokerage, futures investment, consulting, asset management, risk management, and overseas financial services; and life insurance, health insurance, and accident insurance products. It is also involved in trust, reinsurance, and fund investment businesses; managing VC, PE, government-guided funds, and PIPE funds; and develops various strategies, covering fund of funds, long-only equity, offline IPO, discretionary futures, and quantitative strategies.
